تنتجعين (form VIII)
# تَنْتَجِعِينَ (tantajiʕīna) /tan.ta.d͡ʒi.ʕiː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past active indicative of اِنْتَجَعَ (intajaʕa)
# تُنْتَجَعِينَ (tuntajaʕīna) /tun.ta.d͡ʒa.ʕiː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive indicative of اِنْتَجَعَ (intajaʕa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
